name: beehiiv

evidence.newsletter: F02: publication broadcasts and scheduled newsletters
evidence.marketing: F02: welcome and subscriber journeys; the trial allows 10 live automations (F07)

line: Newsletter publishing with growth and paid-subscription tools.

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. The free plan covers up to 2,500 subscribers.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. Billed yearly, Lite works out to $95 a month, but we could not verify the month-to-month price.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. Lite is $139 a month when paid month to month.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails a month. Billed yearly, Lite works out to $249 a month, but we could not verify the month-to-month price.
